method: Actual Three.GLTFLoader skeleton/geometry/animation; only headless texture decoding is replaced. Runtime entry/action/authored return followed by more than two full real Idle loops at 60 Hz. All 180 patched cord vertices use deformed front-chest triangle depth at every frame. All dominant LeftHand/RightHand and finger mesh vertices use actual waist/upper-leg side silhouette depth: Wait at 60 Hz, unchanged performances at 30 Hz. Six actual midperformance transitions involving Wait are separately sampled at 60 Hz for their first second. The worst sample per hand/station is separately replayed and measured with true 3D point-to-triangle distance, outward-normal signed distance, and deduplicated ray parity. No posture correction or synthetic breathing is imported or applied.
limits: The waist/upper-leg bodySide triangle subset is an uncapped, open surface selected from rest-position height and skin weights; it is not a closed solid or a camera-facing-only surface. minimumGapMM and penetratingSamples mean directional side-depth gaps and the count below -0.1 mm, not certified penetration depth or collision count. nearest.signedDistanceMM is the point-to-nearest-tested-triangle vector projected on that triangle normal; it may concern a near or far side surface and is not a closed-volume penetration depth. insideByOddParity records parity of one +X ray against that same open subset, not a proof that the point lies inside a closed body. Six interruption assertions include Wait poses that already have the retained source hand/hip contact, so their negative-gap failures do not independently demonstrate six new transition defects. Side misses are unmeasured, not positive clearance. Finger/sleeve and other body regions are outside coverage. Visible hand silhouette, contact and cloth appearance require the selected left-front camera and actual browser review.
